en.headline: Two men found dead in Lei Tung Estate flat after odour report
en.dek: Security staff at Tung Yip House alerted police around 2:30pm; firefighters forced entry and paramedics confirmed both deaths at the scene.
body: Police are investigating after the bodies of two men were found inside a flat at Tung Yip House, Lei Tung Estate, in Ap Lei Chau on Monday afternoon.
A security guard reported a strong odour coming from the unit at about 2:32pm. Firefighters forced the door and discovered the two men; paramedics confirmed they were already dead.

Sources said the flat’s registered tenant was a 54-year-old man who lived alone and had been out of contact for several days. Police sealed the scene and are continuing inquiries into the circumstances.

zh.headline: 鴨脷洲利東邨單位傳異味 破門揭兩男倒斃
zh.dek: 東業樓保安下午約2時半報案，消防破門入屋發現兩名男子倒斃，救護員證實死亡，警方封鎖現場調查。
body: 警方正調查鴨脷洲利東邨東業樓一單位發現兩名男子倒斃事件。
周一約下午2時32分，保安巡樓時發現單位傳出異味並報警。消防到場破門入內，發現兩名男子倒臥，經救護員檢驗證實已死亡。
消息指單位登記住戶為一名54歲男子，獨居並已失聯多日。警方封鎖現場，繼續調查事件始末。
